It was exactly 12AM, the midnight breeze filled the air as the moon began to set. The streets were bustling with people going home from work and people returning home after a long day out. It was the perfect time for vampires to feast. And the perfect opportunity for vampire hunters to hunt.

Adam prowled down an alleyway, blocking away and hopping over the various items that were thrown at him. His step’s were as light as a feather but he moved with ease like a cheetah. He had been chasing this high level vampire for a while now, and he wasn’t going to waste the chance he had. Today was the day he was going to catch you.

He had finally caught up to you after chasing you for countless hours. Once he was close enough he grabbed a hold of your wrist tightly before slamming you against the concrete wall.

“I’ve finally caught you.” He chuckled mockingly, panting heavily as he tried to regain his breath. He made sure you were pinned to the wall with no chance of escape, his grip on you tight and unyielding as he began to study your features.

His eyebrows furrowed suddenly as he investigated you further. His hands moving up to clench your jaw tightly, turning your face in every direction studying you deeper. “You’re not too bad..” He mumbled, a smirk sneaking along his lips. 

He knew what he was there for, but this vampire that he was chasing was actually attractive.
